senses.gloss: m. (cmp. קדד) hindpart of the head with neck, neck, back (corresp. to h. עֹרֶף).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 5:8">Targ. O. Lev. V, 8</cite> <he>קְדָלֵיה</he>; Y. <he>קוּדְלֵיה</he>, <cite ref="S00871"><he>קִדְ׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="S02204"><he>קְרָ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 49:8">Targ. Gen. XLIX, 8</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 51:6">Ex. R. s. 51</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 33:8">Ex. XXXIII, 8</cite>) they said <he>חמו קְדַל בריה וכ׳</he> see the (fat) neck of Amram’s son! Y. Bets. V, 63ᵃ bot. <he>קְדָלֵיה דר״מ</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00811"><he>פִּיקְיָילִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:6">Lev. R. s. 28</cite> <he>אנא מימיך לך ק׳ וכ׳</he> I shall lower my back for thee, tread upon me and mount the horse; a. e.—Pl. <he>קְדָלִין</he>, <he>קְדָלֵי</he>.
Yalk. Lev. 665 (not קדרון), v. עָרְפָּא.—קרלי דחזירי bacon.
